FAIR SHARE

A house across the street pays more property tax than the Los Angeles Country Club

Tax rate area 00067, all at 1.18738 percent. The club pays $285,533 on 308 acres. A single-family home at 530 S Mapleton Dr pays $436,006 on 1.29 acres.

The numbers

That is
not a
typo.

Proposition 13 (1978) keeps land owned since before 1975 valued from its 1975 figure. The 1960 golf-course rule assesses nonprofit courses on their use as golf courses. Los Angeles Country Club v. Pope (1985) lets the clubs use both rules at once.

The clubs (12)

The clubs do pay property tax. The question people are asking is why the amounts are so small for land in some of the most expensive neighborhoods in the country.
